CRM notes (shorthand):
- Account: Nebula OpsWorks — logistics routing + driver chat + post-trip summarization. Heavy focus on deterministic latencies for routing decisions.
- Primary ask: Dedicated capacity with throughput guarantees and clear upgrade path during seasonal peaks. Wants reserved GPUs behind VPC; eventual on-prem appliance for EU customers.
- Workshop takeaways:
  * Baseline QPS: 60-120 steady, 480 peak bursts.
  * Token distribution skewed: 65% short (<=64t), 25% mid (65-512t), 10% long (>512t).
  * Recommended start: 8x A100-80GB (reserved) + 4x burst; configure KV caching for 70% prefix hit -> reduces effective token/sec by ~30%.
  * Batch size tuning: use dynamic batching with max latency budget 120ms for chat routes, separate low-latency lane for routing decisions.
  * Fallbacks: quantized 4-bit LLM variant for heavy reranking during peaks (cost tradeoff doc linked).
- Security: CISO wants KMS envelope flow + HSM notes; retention controls for PII; compliance proof (ISO27001 artifacts) required.
- Commercial: procurement asked for committed monthly GPU hours and credit table on SLO breaches. Pricing deck v3 in Drive.
- AE notes: Customer pragmatic — 'we will pay for consistency, not for bursts we can't control' (quote on 2026-02-10 call).
- Next steps: deliver a rack-level sizing report + SLA redline by 2026-03-18, schedule procurement handoff, SE to provide quantized perf numbers next week.
